verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents crawling with configurable maximum page limits (500 for sync, up to 25,000 for async batch crawls), satisfying the page-limit part of the story, but no evidence describes a selectable crawl strategy (e.g., breadth-first vs depth-first) as a configurable parameter. Missing for 10: explicit breadth-first strategy option/documentation, evidence of strategy configurability alongside the page limit.
